$comment: Records import (AGL-3671): the console's import wizard, step by step, over /api/transfer/{fields,upload,analyze,plan,apply,status,undo}. Grammar: docs/mobile/native-architecture.md §13.

screens.title: Import records
screens.subtitle: Upload a file, match its columns, review, then import

blocks.text: Choose a spreadsheet (CSV), JSON or NDJSON file. It is read and matched to the fields first, and nothing is written until you have reviewed it. You can undo an import for seven days.

fields.label: File
fields.help: CSV (comma, semicolon, tab or pipe separated), JSON or NDJSON. Spreadsheet text encodings are read as they are.

fields.label: The first row holds the column names

matchReason.typeInference: Looks like this kind of value

blocks.title: Fix before continuing
blocks.primary: {data.info.fields[id=item.fieldId].label|item.fieldId} is chosen for more than one column. Choose one column for it.
“{data.analysis.headers[@item.column]}” is mapped to a field this import cannot write.

prompt.label: Field for this column
prompt.help: A field two columns share, and a required field no column fills, hold the import back.

blocks.title: Values a list does not hold

prompt.label: How it is named in the list

blocks.text: Every value reads as the file has it. Nothing needs a choice here.

normalizer.name: by name, ignoring case and punctuation
normalizer.instant: at the same moment, to the minute

items.label: Change what rows are matched on

prompt.label: Fields that find a record
prompt.help: A row is looked up by each in turn; the first that finds a record wins.

overwrite.label: Overwrite
overwrite.description: The file’s value replaces the record’s.

fillBlanks.label: Fill blanks
fillBlanks.description: Written only where the record has no value.

keepExisting.label: Keep existing
keepExisting.description: Never changed on an existing record.

append.label: Append
append.description: The file’s items are added to the list.

clear.label: Clear the value
clear.description: A blank cell empties the field.

fields.label: A row that matches a record
A row that matches several records

options.label: Let me choose for each row

fields.label: An existing value, when the file has one
fields.help: Fill blanks never replaces a value somebody already has. Anything stronger is your choice, here or per field below.

prompt.label: An existing value, when the file has one

derivation.title: Values read differently from how they were typed
derivation.description: A cell was reformatted to fit its field: a date put in order, a number read with its separators, a name split.

ambiguousDate.title: Dates that read either way
ambiguousDate.description: Day and month could be swapped; they are read in the order you chose.

unmatchedPicklist.title: Values a list does not hold
unmatchedPicklist.description: These values are mapped to another value, left blank, or refuse their rows, as you chose.

newPicklistValue.title: New list values
newPicklistValue.description: These values are added to the organization’s list for everyone.

unresolvedLookup.title: References that name no record
unresolvedLookup.description: Created, mapped, left blank or refused, as you chose.

ambiguousMatch.title: Rows that match more than one record
ambiguousMatch.description: They are skipped unless you chose the record they update.

duplicateInFile.title: Rows repeated in the file
duplicateInFile.description: A later row with the same key as an earlier one is skipped.

lockedRule.title: Values a rule holds back
lockedRule.description: The owning feature never lets a file set these values.

droppedCell.title: Cells that could not be read
droppedCell.description: These cells are dropped; the rest of each row is imported.

overwriteNonBlank.title: Existing values that will be replaced
overwriteNonBlank.description: Records already hold a value here, and the file’s value replaces it.

clearValue.title: Existing values that will be cleared
clearValue.description: A blank cell clears what the record holds, as you chose.

planLimit.title: Rows past what your plan allows
planLimit.description: These rows fail; the rest are imported.

screening.title: What this import’s own checks found
screening.description: The feature you are importing into checked the file for signs of trouble. Each item says what it found and what happens to it.

resourceRule.title: Rows the feature asks you to check
resourceRule.description: The feature that owns these records flags them; each says why. A row it refuses fails, and the rest are imported.

reason.matchedSkipped: Matched a record, and matched rows are skipped
reason.newSkipped: Matched nothing, and new rows are skipped
reason.ambiguousUnresolved: Matched more than one record, and none was chosen
reason.matchedRecordMissing: The matched record no longer exists
reason.resourceRule: Refused by a rule of the feature that owns it
